name: Great Vibes
role: hero headline — the new-session page's motto
credit: Great Vibes by TypeSETit — Copyright 2015 The Great Vibes Pro Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/great-vibes), SIL OFL 1.1
note: The latin subset of Great Vibes v21 as served by Google Fonts, fetched 2026-10-08 and shipped byte for byte in build/great-vibes-latin.woff2 (unmodified). Its unicode-range covers U+0000-00FF, which is what the headline's ü and ä need; none of the four other subsets (cyrillic-ext, cyrillic, greek-ext, vietnamese, latin-ext) is shipped, because a glyph outside this range would fall back rather than be fetched. tools/build-client.mjs reads this record and embeds the file as an @font-face data URL, so the theme still fetches nothing at runtime; build/great-vibes-OFL.txt rides along because OFL condition 2 requires the copyright notice and the licence wherever the font is redistributed. Counted by tools/selfcheck.mjs (font.1 / font.2).
